name: The Fallen Fang
introDiscord:
One Leviathan tooth lies across the seabed like a fallen tower.

Ancient Sentinels patrol around it as though the fang itself deserves
protection.
introTwitch:
One Leviathan tooth lies across the seabed like a fallen tower.

Ancient Sentinels patrol around it as though the fang itself deserves
protection.

the-fallen-fang-approach.prompt: Three routes circle the enormous tooth.

left.message: Star Candies rest inside a crack in the fang.

right.message: An Ancient Tooth Sentinel steps from behind the fallen tooth.

forward.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Found biggest tooth yet.

I am officially done saying that because this region keeps taking it as
challenge.'

the-fallen-fang-depths.prompt: The tooth's exposed growth bands form three pathways.

left.message: A Sentinel blocks the oldest band.

right.message: A navigator's chest rests beneath the fang.

forward.message:
One Berry sits beside Shizuki's rubbing of the growth lines:

'This creature lived long enough for entire places to appear in its
tooth.

That is... a lot.

Keeping this page.'

the-fallen-fang-threshold.prompt: Fang of Ages rises above three final routes.

left.message:
A mineral pocket rests beneath the oldest section.

Shizuki's note:

'Quiet here.

Feels wrong to make joke.

So I won't.'

right.message: An Ancient Tooth Sentinel guards the approach.

forward.message: A strongbox rests beneath centuries of sediment.

boss-antechamber.name: Fang of Ages
boss-antechamber.prompt: The Sentinels kneel around Fang of Ages.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Sentinels kneel around Fang of Ages.

One ancient guardian remains standing.

Its armor bears the same patterns found inside the tooth itself.

Use /yes to approach Fang of Ages or /no to leave the ancient relic
undisturbed.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Sentinels kneel around Fang of Ages.

One ancient guardian remains standing.

Its armor bears the same patterns found inside the tooth itself.

Use !yes to approach Fang of Ages or !no to leave the ancient relic
undisturbed.
bossRetreatText: You step away from the ancient fang.

boss.revealText:
The oldest Sentinel raises its weapon.

Primeval Fangkeeper reveals itself!

completionText:
The Fangkeeper falls silent.

The enormous tooth remains where it has rested for ages.

Whatever carried it once saw parts of the Astral Sea that no longer
exist.
